title: Sandcastle on Sandstone | 5BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Sandcastle on Sandstone is a luxury 5BR Dune Allen home with a saltwater pool and spa. Enjoy park views and 6 adult bikes. Sleeps 16. Reserve today!
description_expanded: Description: Sandcastle on Sandstone by Royal Destinations Location: Dune Allen Beach Address: 52 Sandstone Street, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Nestled on 30A's peaceful west end, this immaculate 5BR/4BA home overlooks Topsail Hill Preserve State Park. This 30A vacation rental features a private neighborhood beach access at the Beach Highlands access just a short drive away. Three large porches provide ample room to enjoy the warm Gulf air, and the rear covered porch overlooks the private backyard with heated saltwater pool and jetted spa. This 3-story Mediterranean-style 30A vacation rental has views overlooking the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park before the Gulf of Mexico. With 4 king bedrooms, a custom bunkroom (2 queen and 2 twin beds), and 4 bathrooms, this home is perfect for large families or multiple families vacationing together. Sandcastle on Sandstone features a backyard oasis complete with a large, covered patio and two covered terraces that wrap around the entire home, granting you the perfect place to relax and enjoy the fresh Gulf air. Guests can spend long days lounging on the white sand beaches and cool off with a refreshing dip in the private pool. Those searching for 30A vacation rentals with private pool are sure to enjoy this heated saltwater pool complete with ample poolside seating. This Dune Allen vacation rental is sure to be your favorite 30A escape! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Private Neighborhood Beach Access (Beach Highland and Stallworth) Just A Short Drive Away - *3 Beach Accesses Within 1 Mile (Highland Beach Access- 0.6 Miles; Dune Allen Regional Beach Access- 0.8 Miles; Dune Allen/Fort Panic Beach Access- 1 Mile) - 6 Adult Bikes - Spacious Porches Throughout - Wi-Fi - *Private Heated Courtyard Pool *Pool heat is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional $100 a night (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. - Elevator available for guests who require accessibility assistance. (Please contact our team prior to arrival to arrange access.) Sleeping Arrangements (16): First floor: - Bedroom 1 - King Suite, Private Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) - Lanai and Private Heated Pool Second Floor: - Bedroom 2 - King Bed, Detached Bath (Shower) - Kitchen, Great Room, Half Bath Third Floor: - Bedroom 3 - King Suite Private Bath (Spa Shower, Soaking Tub), Private Balcony, Sleeper Sofa - Bedroom 4 – King, Shared Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) - Bedroom 5 – Bunk Room, Two Twin/Queen Bunks Shared Bath -Laundry Room Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *Dune Allen Regional Beach Access and Dune Allen Beach/Fort Panic Access Have Seasonal Lifeguards, Parking, Beach Conditions Flag, ADA Accessible Restrooms, ADA Accessible Boardwalk, ADA Accessible Parking and Water Fountains. *The beach access for this home does require you to drive over. *The main living room tv is the only tv with cable and the master bedroom is only streaming. *The elevator in this home is reserved for guests who require accessibility assistance. Please contact our team prior to arrival to arrange access. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
